If the user genuinely does not know, the agent starts unknown-hardware discovery:"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- On macOS, unknown hardware first uses read-only raw **CoreBluetooth** advertisement discovery, wit"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"hout starting Intiface or connecting to devices.
- Regular Bluetooth, serial, and USB models use **B"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"uttplug / Intiface**. The plugin starts local Intiface Engine automatically when needed.
- Known sha"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"ring-link models from Ankni (安可尼), MizzZee (谜姬), and Zuiqingfeng (醉清风) use **MonsterParty**. Known d"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"ual-output devices expose their channels separately."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Users do not need to understand or select an underlying connection method, or manually start Intifac"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ers do not need to understand or select an underlying connection method, or manually start Intiface."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Brand and model names are not an allowlist. The agent passes any user-reported name through unchange"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"d; unfamiliar names still use local hardware discovery. The plugin also supplies a verified local co"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"mpatibility mapping for `RoomFun` devices reporting model `RF_CANNON_PT3`, exposed as **RoomFun Cann"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"on** with one vibration channel."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"The implementation follows protocol observations from Chemtrails, together with the device model and"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" message formats documented by Buttplug and the Buttplug Protocol Specification. This repository con"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"tains an independent TypeScript implementation; see NOTICE for attribution."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Guardrails"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- Sharing tokens stay in plugin configuration and never appear in model-visible tool arguments or re"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"sults.
- Raw BLE discovery is read-only: it scans connectable advertisements without connecting or w"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"riting characteristics.
- Output stops automatically after 30 seconds by default.
- Zero-duration ho"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"lds are disabled unless `allowHold: true` is explicitly configured.
- `maxIntensityPercent` and `max"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"DurationSeconds` are enforced before backend dispatch.
- A newer command replaces the previous autom"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"atic-stop timer for the same device.
- `toy_stop` without a device id performs a global stop.
- Plug"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"in unload, HMR, and `toy_disconnect` stop output and await WebSocket shutdown."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Use only hardware you own or are explicitly authorized to control. Treat sharing tokens as temporary"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" control credentials and keep them out of Git, logs, and conversations."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Requirements: Node.js 22.19 or newer and pnpm on `PATH`. Raw macOS BLE discovery additionally uses t"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"he Swift compiler from Xcode Command Line Tools. Re-running DS"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"H does not reinstall it. If the scan exposes a plausible advertised name,"},{"id":"p26s2","text":" it uses that hardware-reported name for `toy_connect`; otherwise it falls back to `unknown`, connec"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"ts Intiface automatically, and scans verified protocols. Before scanning, turn the toy on, keep it n"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"earby, and make sure a phone app or another program is not holding the device connection."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Automatic selection and connection"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Before calling `toy_connect`, the agent must ask for the model and pass it to the tool, together wit"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"h the brand when known. When the user does not know, macOS first runs `toy_scan_raw_ble` directly th"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"rough CoreBluetooth. A discovered advertisement name is hardware evidence and may be passed to `toy_"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"connect`; raw BLE ids are never controllable device ids. If raw discovery is unavailable or inconclu"},{"id":"p28s5","text":"sive, the agent passes `unknown` and the system tries the Intiface fallback. The tool never asks the"},{"id":"p28s6","text":" user to select an underlying protocol."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"For a brand or model that is not already documented, the agent follows the same path: pass the repor"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"ted text to `toy_connect`, then call `toy_scan`. It must not guess a protocol or write arbitrary BLE"},{"id":"p29s3","text":" characteristics. Discovery returns only devices covered by an upstream Intiface definition or a com"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"patibility mapping that has been verified against hardware. An empty scan means the device remains u"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"nsupported or unavailable, not that the agent should probe it destructively."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"For local Bluetooth, serial, and USB devices, the system first tries an existing Intiface server. If"},{"id":"p30s2","text":" `127.0.0.1:12345` refuses the connection, the plugin runs:"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"The plugin first looks for Intiface Engine on `PATH`. If it is not installed, it downloads a pinned "},{"id":"p32s2","text":"build from the official Buttplug GitHub Release, verifies its SHA-256 digest, caches it in the user "},{"id":"p32s3","text":"cache directory, and starts it. Set `intifaceAutoDownload: false` to disable downloads or `intifaceE"},{"id":"p32s4","text":"xecutable` to use another path. On disconnect or unload, the plugin stops only the process it starte"},{"id":"p32s5","text":"d; it does not stop an Intiface server that was already running."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"- The MonsterParty connection implements the relay behavior and `AKN_DS_SUCKEGG` mapping documented "},{"id":"p35s2","text":"by Chemtrails. Vendor-side protocol changes may require an update.
- The built-in RoomFun mapping is"},{"id":"p35s3","text":" hardware-verified for BLE name `RoomFun`, model identifier `RF_CANNON_PT3`, firmware `4.3`, and one"},{"id":"p35s4","text":" vibration output. Other RoomFun models are not assumed compatible.
- Raw BLE advertisement discover"},{"id":"p35s5","text":"y is macOS-only and requires the Swift compiler from Xcode Command Line Tools. It is read-only disco"},{"id":"p35s6","text":"very, not a generic unknown-device control protocol.
- The Buttplug connection currently exposes sca"},{"id":"p35s7","text":"lar features only; position, direction, sensors, raw access, and subscriptions are outside the curre"},{"id":"p35s8","text":"nt scope.
- Tests use local protocol fixtures rather than physical hardware.
- Device ids should be "},{"id":"p35s9","text":"refreshed with `toy_list` after reconnection."}],"truncated":true}
